title: occ20210514_8k.htm
主要内容: Optical Cable Corporation (“OCC”) was awarded a contract to supply its proprietary products to a major defense contractor for the U.S. Department of Defense. The contract includes a purchase order totaling more than $1.0 million. The Company expects to begin manufacturing the products in the fiscal third quarter of 2021 and continue throughout fiscal year 2021. Further details regarding the contract were not disclosed.
